correctness.rationale: For the corrected claim, a homogeneous endpoint cannot flip under degree-two tie retention. Any homogeneous interior rung in a fully flipping state forces neighboring homogeneous opposite rungs and hence contradiction at an end. Thus every rung is mixed. Complementary rails reduce local flip constraints exactly to d_1=d_{n-1}=1 and no consecutive zero indicators, including n=2. The free n-3 indicators (n>=3) have F_{n-1} choices, and the first rail bit doubles them. Complement equivariance pairs all states into F_{n-1} primitive two-cycle orbits. Independent exhaustive direct simulation on all 4^n states for n=2,...,9 agrees. Comparison with the earlier established all-two-periodic population yields the displayed asymptotic; no finite-to-infinite extrapolation.
